verdict.rationale: LangSmith's docs describe the full programmatic workflow—creating datasets from curated/production/synthetic data, defining evaluators, and executing experiments—plus SDK support (Python/TS/Go/Java) and API access to traces, implying an agent could automate this pipeline. However, no evidence pack item shows an explicit code example for creating a dataset, launching an eval run, and reading back results, so this capability is inferred rather than directly demonstrated.
